create_ion_from_atoms: create an Ion object by passing an ase.Atoms object directly to the constructor
create_ion_from_db_index: create an Ion object by passing an ion_id_from_db index to select from the ion database
create_ion_random: create an Ion object that randomly selects an ion from the database when no arguments are provided
get_ion_concentration: get the ion concentration in Molar units given a volume in Angstrom cubed
load_ion_from_db: load an ion from the pickle database using the _load_ion internal method with a dictionary
